prompt_en: Photograph a woman taking part in palace court life in a fictional late-eighteenth-century European palace court. Use the supplied portrait as the reference for her visible face and hair: the short dark bob, separated wispy fringe, dark eyes and softly rounded facial contours remain recognizable. Her clothing and the scene are newly staged. Three aligned open doorways reveal a succession of inner rooms along one clear axis. At the first doorway, the palace usher guards the passage and separates the two waiting courtiers outside from the woman already admitted inside. The woman stands one pace beyond the first brass threshold, close to the left jamb, leaving the aligned view through all three doorways open beside her. Both of her shoes rest on the inner parquet floor. Her body is turned slightly inward, while her face turns back toward the usher in a gentle three-quarter view that stays readable from the camera outside. Her left hand holds a closed ivory-colored folding fan at waist height; her right hand falls naturally beside the blue silk skirt. The usher stands at the right jamb of the first doorway, his left hand around the open door's handle and his right palm extended low toward the empty route into the next room. They look toward each other. Her slightly parted lips and attentive gaze carry a private breath of anticipation within a public ceremony. A pale blue silk court gown has a fitted square-neck bodice, elbow-length lace cuffs and a broad structured skirt whose folds catch the window light. The usher wears an embroidered dark coat and knee breeches. The two waiting courtiers stand several paces behind the first threshold on the outer antechamber floor, turned toward the same doorway, with a clear interval between them and the usher. Pale paneling and gilt pilasters surround the first doorway; the second open doorway reveals a red-walled inner room, and the third reveals a deeper chamber with a raised empty chair. The three complete rectangular doorframes decrease in apparent size along their shared axis. Compose a full-length vertical photograph from the outer antechamber, close enough for the woman's face and the usher's hands to remain distinct while retaining the first threshold, the two outside courtiers, and all three nested doorframes together. Her skirt and the usher's body occupy opposite sides of the first opening rather than covering the deeper doorway centers. Cool afternoon window light shapes her face and the blue silk against the warmer inner rooms. Use realistic skin texture, tactile silk, controlled gilded highlights and enough depth of field for the social spacing and doorway sequence to read together. The visual center is her attentive turn back across the threshold after being allowed through, with her quiet presence carrying the portrait's subtle attraction.
